cases.name: four_parts
cases.expected: Four independently restored part recipes; changing each unlocked part changes only its own leaves.

cases.name: locks_lr
cases.expected: LR lock updates same lid on both eyes atomically; lower/upper remains independent when UD is unlocked.

cases.name: locks_ud
cases.expected: UD lock updates both lids on same eye atomically; other eye independent when LR is unlocked.

cases.name: locks_all
cases.expected: Both locks update all four; partial linked payload rejects with no graph/history/image publication.

cases.name: relink
cases.expected: Relink chooses current side/lid consistently for every newly linked pair; no mismatch or silent loss.

cases.name: catalogue
cases.expected: 14 distinct pinned original profiles; each visually accepted on upper/lower left/right at proxy and source resolution.

cases.name: neutral
cases.expected: All zero strengths produce bit-exact no change.

cases.name: source_binding
cases.expected: Source hash, landmark hash, face instance/revision mismatch rejects review/render.

cases.name: root_extension
cases.expected: No lash without reviewed real root AND separate reviewed full extension zone; eyeliner review cannot authorize it.

cases.name: unseen
cases.expected: Profile/closed/cropped/tiny/degenerate/hidden portions are not reconstructed; active unsupported part rejects.

cases.name: occluders
cases.expected: Glasses frames/lenses reflection, hair, hands and other faces remain unchanged outside reviewed/exclusion ownership.

cases.name: dense_sampling
cases.expected: Thin occluder across fibre centreline rejects fibre; render mask preserves all forbidden pixels including antialias footprint.

cases.name: atomic_render
cases.expected: Failure on fourth part leaves earlier three unpublished; repeat across multi-person targets.

cases.name: float_render
cases.expected: Working-sRGB float32 delta and deterministic native output; no 8-bit intermediate.

cases.name: scale_rotation
cases.expected: Observed roots track rotated faces and native source export; masks rerasterized from normalized vectors.

cases.name: recovery
cases.expected: Canonical recovery removes only eyelash contribution and restores through undo/redo; no cloned owner.

cases.name: history
cases.expected: Edit/review/palette each follow one canonical correlated receipt and undo/redo; rejected mutation leaves previous state.

cases.name: project
cases.expected: Roundtrip current and dormant four-part recipes, locks, palette digest and historical support; tampering rejects before install.

cases.name: preset_batch
cases.expected: Only intent transfers; every batch target must independently validate person, root/extension evidence; no source masks copied.

cases.name: colour_recommendations
cases.expected: Every profile offers its own recommended group and selection updates the exact linked component.

cases.name: picker_frame
cases.expected: Accept only PRESENTED proxy working-sRGB float frame matching capture generation, document epoch and sample descriptor.

cases.name: picker_race
cases.expected: Document/target/revision change, cancellation, competing owner, stale click or duplicate apply cannot publish colour.

cases.name: rgb
cases.expected: Integer 0–255 RGB only; bool/fraction/NaN/overflow refused and equivalent HEX matches.

cases.name: hex
cases.expected: Only six-digit #RRGGBB accepted; normalized uppercase.

cases.name: six_favourites
cases.expected: Save six unique colours, reject seventh without replacing any; duplicate idempotent; remove/re-add and project history work.

cases.name: native_budget
cases.expected: Missing native/ABI mismatch/nonfinite/ROI budget errors reject visibly; no download, inference, compiler or fallback.

cases.name: no_change
cases.expected: Exact same target colour or zero coverage reports no measurable change, never fabricated application success.

cases.name: ui_review
cases.expected: 64 point records per zone, subtract edits, per-part confirmations, correct original-image source/size and context reset; review no cross-point connection.
